model.description: A small Chinese text encoder running locally in Transformers.js and producing normalized 512-dimensional CLS-pooled vectors for retrieval and similarity.
limitations: Designed for Chinese; cross-language retrieval is not certified.
Inputs beyond 512 tokens are truncated; chunk longer documents.
Use the upstream retrieval instruction on queries, not passages; the worker does not add prefixes automatically.
Cosine similarities are not calibrated probabilities or evidence that claims are true.
Domain-specific text and close rankings require application evaluation.
Embeddings may retain training-data biases; do not use similarity alone for consequential decisions.

fixture.source: WebAI-authored English/Chinese retrieval examples with upstream BGE query instruction
fixture.preprocessing: Caller supplies query instruction; tokenizer truncation at 512 tokens; normalized CLS pooling.

benchmark.qualityGate: Finite normalized distinct 512d vectors; relevant passage cosine exceeds unrelated passage by >=0.1.
